title: Sharp Spectral Bounds for the $p$-Laplacian and Polyharmonic Operators on Asymptotically Hyperbolic Manifolds
summary: We derive sharp bounds for three types of eigenvalue problems. First, we derive an upper bound for the first $p$-Dirichlet eigenvalue on conformally compact (CC) spaces. As a consequence, we show that for a class of CC submanifolds of asymptotically hyperbolic spaces, the asymptotic sectional curvatures, the meeting angle at infinity, and the vanishing of the norm of the mean curvature are all determined by its first $p$-Dirichlet eigenvalue. Additionally, we derive sharp upper bounds for the first eigenvalue of polyharmonic operators under both clamped and buckling boundary conditions.…
